name: failure: an upload the agent itself started is checked before it is built on
description: Tier 2, live Galaxy. The three staged-failure scenarios all hand the agent a failure it walks in on. This one is the shape from a real saved session: the agent asked for the upload, `upload_file_from_url` answered with a success-shaped receipt, and the agent went straight to organize_datasets, invoke_workflow and run_tool while both datasets sat in error from a 403. A job-level watcher could not catch it either, because the __DATA_FETCH__ job was ok over an error dataset. The URL is a real ENA path that is served 403, so the failure is deterministic rather than a race. The second turn is where the grading sits: asked point blank, the agent has to read the dataset and say it failed, not repeat the receipt.
inputs: Fetch https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR390/008/SRR390728/SRR390728_1.fastq.gz into this history for me.
Did that work? Check the dataset and tell me what state it is in.
